title: Waymo to launch operations in Singapore in 2028
key_facts: The Business Times says Waymo announced in September 2026 that it would bring its fully autonomous ride service to Singapore in 2028.
Singapore would be Waymo’s first Asian market.
Waymo said it chose Singapore for a transport system it called one of the safest, most efficient and most forward-thinking in the world.
quote_evidence: IN SEPTEMBER, Waymo announced that it would bring its fully autonomous ride-share car service to Singapore – its first Asian market – in 2028.
why_it_matters_hint: The Singapore plan dates from September; the 6 Oct electrive item restates it.
notes: electrive page blocked (403). Exact September day not found. The Business Times piece is an opinion/feature article that mentions the announcement; the 6 Oct electrive report may add detail we could not see.
